pages.label: Getting started
pages.summary: Start Pier on your computer in two lines, finish setup, add your first bins, items and team.

pages.label: Orders and dispatch
pages.summary: Take an order that reserves real stock, dispatch it in parts and bring returns back through quarantine.

pages.label: Buy and receive
pages.summary: Keep supplier terms, approve the exact purchase order and receive what arrives into named bins.

pages.label: Transfers and counts
pages.summary: Move stock between warehouses through transit, and count a bin without overwriting work in progress.

pages.label: Activity and proposals
pages.summary: Follow any quantity to the document, person and reason behind it, and review an agent's proposals.

sections.title: Move in and keep it safe

pages.label: Moving in from CSV
pages.summary: Bring items, bins, opening stock and open orders from CSV files, reviewed before one cutover.

pages.label: Backup and restore
pages.summary: Keep a complete archive of your installation and restore it with the release that made it.
